name: match_id
description: Match identifier, joins matches.match_id. 1..104 in chronological order.

name: stage
description: Stage: Group stage, Round of 32, Round of 16, Quarter-final, Semi-final, Third place, Final.

name: stage_order
description: Stage order for sorting: 1 = Group stage ... 6 = Third place, 7 = Final.

name: player_name
description: Player name with accents as published by FIFA, e.g. 'Kylian Mbappé', 'Warren Zaïre-Emery'. Display this.

name: player_search_name
description: Player name in lower-case ASCII without accents or punctuation, e.g. 'kylian mbappe', 'warren zaire emery'. Filter on this with LIKE.

name: team
description: National team (English name), e.g. 'France', 'United States', 'Ivory Coast', 'South Korea'.

name: position
description: Position code: GK, DF, MF, FW.

name: started
description: TRUE if the player was in the starting XI, FALSE if he came on as a substitute.

name: minutes_played
description: Minutes played in this match (90, or 120 with extra time; stoppage time not counted).

name: goals
description: Goals scored in this match (own goals excluded).

name: penalty_goals
description: Penalty goals in this match (shoot-outs excluded).

name: team_goals
description: Goals scored by the player's team in this match (after extra time).

name: opponent_goals
description: Goals scored by the opponent (after extra time).

name: result
description: Result for the player's team: W, D or L. A match won on penalties is W, lost on penalties is L.
